description.value: Established in 1981, Black's Cycle is a long-running full-service bicycle shop in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island, widely regarded as the area's go-to cycling resource. The shop specializes in electric and mountain bikes and stocks an extensive range of parts, accessories, and clothing. Touring cyclists will find it a well-equipped stop for repairs and supplies, including panniers and e-bike-specific components.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 62m; rack (3 spaces) at 79m. Total: 13 spaces.

The website lists panniers under accessories, confirming some touring-relevant stock, and has a dedicated /collections/electric-bike-repair-parts page.
